sn45.83:1.2: Yonisomanasikārasampannassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pātikaṅkhaṃ ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati a- amaggam bahulīkarissati || ||
sn45.83:1.3: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn45.83:1.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || pa [pe] || sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || pa || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- viraga- nirodhanissitam vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn45.83:1.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno a- a- maggam bhāveti a- amaggam bahulīkarotī ti || || 2.
